messages:
maria-release: Kicking off tenant metadata swap in the 02:00 UTC quiet window. Plan: stagger by tenant-range groups, small backfills, pin service to 3.4.2 for the swap. Rollout groups: 0-9 -> 10-29 -> 30-99. Abort criteria: any single table lock > 5s OR replication lag > 30s. tagging @jason-oncall @kevin :eyes:
kevin: Ack. I'll watch p99 latency + replica lag. Which dashboard to watch?
sree: Quick Q — escape hatch steps documented? who runs the revert script?
maria-release: Yes, runbook link in the release notes (added). Practical escape: revert pk_swap flag + pin workers back to 3.4.1 + run revert backfill. Manual steps below if needed:
```sql
-- revert tenant metadata swap for a group
BEGIN;
UPDATE tenants SET metadata_version = 'v1' WHERE tenant_range BETWEEN 30 AND 39;
COMMIT;
```
jason-oncall: I'll be on standby during the rollout window. Ops channel open. tagging @ops-bot
deploybot: deploybot: starting rollout group 0 (tenant ranges 0-9). exp ETA ~6m. logs will stream to #release-stream
anna-prod: Group 0 finished — checks: no locks >100ms, p99 latency unchanged, replica lag steady. :thumbsup:
kevin: Noted — starting group 1 (10-29) now. Watchers on dashboard: https://perf.redwood.internal/dashboards/migration
kevin: saw transient p99 jump +120ms for ~30s shortly after group1 start, but locks under 200ms. still below abort threshold.
maria-release: Holdpoint before group2. Kevin — can you capture a pg_locks sample + tail of application logs for the window? If replication lag >30s at any point we abort.
jason-oncall: pg_locks sample (excerpt): `pid=2345 rel=tenant_meta mode=AccessExclusive granted=false wait=0.2s` — nothing persistent. tail logs show a flurry of backfill rows: 
`[2026-03-23T02:05:14Z] backfill: group=10-19 processed=120 batch_ms=95`
deploybot: deploybot: attempted to start group 2 but paused due to manual hold. queued retry in 5m.
kevin: I suggest reducing batch size for subsequent groups — drop from 200 -> 50 and add 100ms sleep between batches. less lock pressure.
maria-release: Agreed. Applying adjusted run config: `BATCH_SIZE=50 SLEEP_MS=100`. We'll retry group2 after config update. If we see >5s locks we will run revert for the affected group.
kevin: I'll push the config update to deploybot now.
deploybot: deploybot: updated config `migration_batch_size` -> "50", `migration_sleep_ms` -> "100". scheduled group2 retry in 2m.
anna-prod: group2 retry started. early telemetry: p50/p95 fine, p99 slightly elevated (~80ms), no locks >1s.
sree: doc note: update release notes with the adjusted batch settings + rollback steps so SRE oncall can follow without hunting.
maria-release: Done — release notes updated under the release artifact and in the runbook. If we need to rollback: run `scripts/tenant_meta_revert.sh --group <n>` and open incident with tag `migration-rollback`. Keep me posted.
kevin: :eyes: monitoring. If anything looks off I'll call abort.
jason-oncall: I'll stay on-call for 30m after the last group completes.
maria-release: Thanks team. Continuing careful stagger; will post final completion when group 30-99 finishes or earlier if we abort.
